name: ecb_get_inflation
description:
Euro area HICP inflation, annual rate of change in percent, monthly: overall, core (excluding energy and food) or energy, from the ECB's HICP dataflow (HICP.M.U2.N.<item>.4D0.ANR; the ECB retired the older ICP dataflow in February 2026).
Returns: flow, key, series_name (the ECB title), description, unit, unit_multiplier, frequency, source, observation_count and observations (date, value) oldest first; a note when the period has no observations.
Inputs (none required): inflation_type (overall, core, energy; default overall); start_date, end_date (YYYY-MM-DD, YYYY-MM or YYYY); recent_periods (1-100; default 12; the last N observations of the series whatever its frequency, used only when neither date is given).
For other series use ecb_get_series; for France bdf_get_french_indicator.
Example: {"inflation_type": "core", "recent_periods": 24}

observations.description: Historical inflation values (annual rate of change)

date.description: Date of inflation reading (YYYY-MM format for monthly)

metadata.author: Ashutosh Sinha
metadata.note: HICP (Harmonised Index of Consumer Prices) is the official inflation measure for the Euro Area. Core inflation excludes energy and food. ECB targets 2% inflation.

inflationTypes.overall: HICP - All items. The broadest measure of consumer price inflation.
inflationTypes.core: HICP excluding energy and food. Provides better signal of underlying inflation trends.
inflationTypes.energy: HICP - Energy component only. Most volatile component of inflation.
